steps.what: Show the plan sheet and the contract term asked about.
Explain plans and contract terms to the owner.
Note what was explained and what was not promised.

tasks.design: The drawing sheet and the contract term are shown from {DOCS} and {CLM}. The construction manager explains them to the owner, the developer's staff, workers, or clients. The screen does not explain and does not make a new promise. The note records what was said. A question that is really a change of scope is stopped and treated as a change, not as an explanation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Explanations were given from memory of the clause, and the owner later treated a guess as a promise.
tasks.enabler_now: The clause and the sheet can be on the table. The words to the owner are still the manager's.
tasks.still_hard: A person who wants a promise, a drawing that is out of date, and a term that conflicts with the drawing.
tasks.human_edge: The manager hears when an explanation is about to become a variation.
tasks.altitude: The right sheet is in the meeting. Explaining it, and refusing a new promise, stay with the manager.

reach.task: Explain a project constraint to a landowner without granting a new right.
reach.learn: The document can be shown. The explanation, and the limit of it, stay with this manager.

evidence.claim: A store can open a named sheet and a named clause. It cannot explain them to an owner.
A promise about time or money is a contractual act. The manager makes it, or refuses it, in the conversation. The note is not a variation order.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Sheet id or clause id, produced by the question. If neither id is known, the screen does not guess a document. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the existing drawing and contract stores.
unknowns: Which staff may explain a term besides this manager.
When an explanation must be confirmed in writing.
research_questions: Do questions arrive with a sheet or clause id?
How often does an explanation become a dispute?

already_counted.description: The manager still explains the plan and the term.
The manager still notes what was and was not promised.

incremental.description: The manager flags a sheet that is no longer current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The conversation is the task. Saving is finding the sheet and the clause, and it shrinks when the question names neither and the manager still searches.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Change the plan for delay, weather, or emergency.

steps.what: Show activities hit by the delay or the weather.
Implement modified plans after weather or emergencies.
Issue the changed plan to the site.

tasks.design: Activities whose dates collide with a delay or a weather notice are listed from {PROJECT}. The construction manager implements the modified plan, including for a site emergency, and issues it. The list does not move the work. An emergency that is not yet a dated activity is handled by the manager before any replan.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan was rebuilt overnight from phone calls, and the site worked to the old one until noon.
tasks.enabler_now: Dated activities can be listed against a known delay. The response is still a decision on the day.
tasks.still_hard: A sudden emergency, a forecast that is wrong, and a client who will not accept the new date.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows what can safely stop and what becomes more dangerous if it stops.
tasks.altitude: The hit list is quick. Changing the plan and issuing it stay with the manager, especially when the event is an emergency rather than a date.

reach.task: Decide what stops immediately when a site is unsafe, and tell the people there.
reach.learn: A list of dated tasks is not an emergency decision. This manager still makes it.

evidence.claim: A plan can list activities that overlap a known date. It cannot respond to an emergency that has no date yet.
Changing the plan can change safety and the contract. The manager issues the change. No automatic reassignment of named crews is included.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Activity id and planned date, produced by the schedule. Delay or weather date, produced by the notice. If there is no notice and no dated activity, the list is empty and the manager acts from the site. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Filter the existing plan rather than building a new one.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: Who may stop work in an emergency.
Which weather source the contract recognises.
research_questions: Are delays written as dates on activities?
How fast does the site hear about a change today?

already_counted.description: The manager still decides the modified plan.
The manager still issues the change.

incremental.description: The manager records which weather notice the contract accepts.

approvals.approved_version: change id and the revised dates shown to the manager

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Emergencies and real replans stay with the manager. Saving is listing dated activities against a known delay, and it is small when the event has no date yet.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List materials short of the planned quantity.
Decide which supplies and materials to requisition.
Send the requisition for this construction project.

tasks.design: Materials short of the planned quantity are listed from {PROCUREMENT} and {PROJECT}. The construction manager decides which supplies to requisition for the project, including substitutes and timing. Only that decision is sent. A shortage is not an order. A line with no quantity is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Shortages were noticed when the trade stopped, and the order was a phone call with no quantity.
tasks.enabler_now: A quantity against a plan can show a gap. Whether to buy, and when, is still the manager.
tasks.still_hard: A substitute that fits the specification, a long lead time, and a site that will waste what arrives early.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows what the crew will actually use next week, not only what the model says is short.

ambition.what: Raise a requisition the same day for a small material whose quantity is already known, not only for the large orders.

tasks.altitude: The gap is visible sooner. The manager still decides the requisition. Purchasing sends nothing the manager did not sign.

reach.task: Order only the quantity the plan still lacks, after a person confirms it.
reach.learn: A shortage list is not an order. This manager still decides.

evidence.claim: Stock against a planned quantity can show a gap. It cannot choose a substitute or a delivery week.
Sending a requisition spends money. The manager signs it first. The job digest treats purchasing records as structured and the decision as a person's.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Material id, planned quantity, and on-hand quantity, produced by the project quantities and the purchasing stock. A missing quantity stops the line. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the existing requisition screen before a new buying tool.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: What value this manager may requisition alone.
Who places the order with the supplier after the requisition.
research_questions: Are site quantities in the same codes as purchasing?
How often is a requisition a substitute rather than the planned item?

already_counted.description: The manager still decides what to requisition.

incremental.description: The manager adds a material code when the specification uses a new item.

approvals.approved_version: material ids and quantities the manager decided
signed requisition id about to be sent

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The decision stays with the manager, so the net stays under half. Saving is the shortage list, and it shrinks when stock figures are late and the manager still counts on site.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Apply for the necessary permits and licences.

steps.what: List the permits this building type requires.
Apply for the necessary permits and licenses.
Sign the application before it is filed.

tasks.design: A list of permits and licences usual for this building type is shown from {DOCS}. The construction manager prepares the application against the drawings and signs it before it is filed on {GOV_PORTAL}. The list does not obtain the permit. A permit the list does not contain, but the authority requires, is added by the manager. National rules decide which permits exist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Permit needs were remembered from the last town, and a missing consent stopped work late.
tasks.enabler_now: A building type can open a usual list. The application and the signature stay with the manager.
tasks.still_hard: A local consent the list has never seen, a drawing that is not the one to be built, and an authority portal that still wants paper.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which drawing is the one the authority should see, and which promise in the form the programme cannot keep.
tasks.altitude: The usual permits are listed at the start. Applying and signing stay with the manager. The portal does not obtain the permit.

reach.task: Keep the list of filings a project must make, and leave the filing itself to the person who can stand behind it.
reach.learn: A list is not a permit. This manager still signs the application.

evidence.claim: A building type can be tied to a list of usual permits. The list cannot complete an application the authority has changed.
Filing for a permit is a legal act. The manager signs it. The job digest's obligation register can hold the list and the due date. It does not decide that the application is true.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Building type and permit id, produced by the permit catalogue for this authority. Drawing revision id must be present or the application stops. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the existing permit checklist before a new tracker.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: Which authority issues which permit for this site.
Whether the portal accepts a filing from this manager.
research_questions: Is the permit catalogue specific to this municipality?

already_counted.description: The manager still prepares the application.
The manager still signs and files it.

incremental.description: The manager adds a permit when this authority requires one the catalogue lacks.

approvals.approved_version: permit id, drawing revision, and the application text shown to the manager

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Preparing and signing the application stay with the manager. Saving is the usual list, and it shrinks when the authority's list is local and not the one on file.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still explains the plan, still changes it for weather or an emergency, and still signs a permit application. A material shortage and a permit list can be prepared first.
reach: Compliance managers keep the permit list, and this job learns the list is not the application.
Wind energy development managers explain a constraint to a landowner, and this job learns the explanation stays a conversation.
skills_to_grow: Explain a contract term from the clause, and stop when the question is a new promise.
Send a requisition only after the quantity and the need are signed.
role.ambitious_version: A permit this building type always needs is listed before the application starts, and the manager still signs what is filed.
